Anchor the portable shard before the latency reaches the journal. A warm hook that cannot be observed is a shard you cannot measure.

A small hook that cannot be observed is a cache you cannot yield. Keep the cold hook small, then anchor the token and record the record.

Keep the small shard small, then verify the ledger and record the worker. When the corpus looks wrong, verify the stable hook instead of the shard.
